scope: A product manual-input contract for one active permanent Mercenary. It does not assert the actual labels or aggregation behavior of any in-game sheet.

retention.sourceLicense: GGG page licensing is not stated in the inspected patch notes.
retention.dataLicense: No third-party data is retained; this artifact is a Golden Glory Lab product-contract record.
retention.provenance: Manually authored from AUD-002 claims and the registered GGG announcement records.
retention.redistribution: No copied GGG prose, UI image, or game-data payload is retained.
retention.derivation: The records formalize a non-double-counting input safeguard; they do not derive a game value.
retention.attribution: Source IDs and source URLs are retained in the source registry and AUD-002.
retention.retainedMaterial: Stable field IDs, product labels, input states, and claim/source references only.
retention.notVendored: No screenshots, raw item instances, UI strings, client data, or third-party tables are vendored.
retention.uncertainty: Actual sheet field labels, units, inclusion, conditions, and display precision remain unknown.
